description_html:
Key Features

  • Spacious Acoustic Test Cell: Offers a generous floor area of 120 square metres, providing ample space for group testing, sound experiments, or collaborative acoustic research.
  • Low Noise Floor: Engineered for precision, the test cell maintains a noise floor of just 27 dBA, supporting highly accurate acoustic measurements and minimizing background interference.
  • Group Capacity: Designed to accommodate up to 17 occupants comfortably, making it suitable for team-based testing, training sessions, or multi-user research scenarios.
  • Extended Session Length: Each booking allows for sessions up to 5 hours, ideal for comprehensive testing, extended experiments, or detailed analysis without interruption.
  • Advanced Sound Isolation: Utilizes a mass wall isolation method, effectively reducing external noise intrusion and ensuring consistent acoustic conditions throughout each session.
  • Flexible Pricing: Session fees are determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored pricing based on specific project requirements or session needs.

Main Benefits

  • Accurate Acoustic Measurements: The low ambient noise level and robust sound isolation support precise sound testing, ideal for audio engineers, researchers, and product developers seeking reliable results.
  • Versatile Usage: The large space and high occupancy capacity make this test cell suitable for a range of activities, including group research, product demonstrations, acoustic training, or equipment calibration.
  • User Convenience: Extended session times and a comfortable environment enable users to focus on their work without frequent interruptions or space limitations.
  • Customizable Access: Flexible session fees ensure you only pay for the services and duration you need, optimizing value for both short and long-term projects.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Acoustic Research and Testing: Ideal for professionals conducting sound quality assessments, noise control studies, or audio equipment evaluations in a controlled environment.
  • Product Development: Supports manufacturers and engineers in testing new audio devices, speakers, or microphones, ensuring products meet strict acoustic standards.
  • Team Training and Workshops: Accommodates group sessions for educational purposes, technical training, or collaborative research, all within a quiet, acoustically optimized space.

Common User Questions Addressed

  • Is the space suitable for group work or large equipment? Yes, the 120 m² area and 17-person capacity support both group projects and sizeable testing setups.
  • How quiet is the environment for sensitive measurements? The 27 dBA noise floor ensures minimal background noise, ideal for precise acoustic experiments.
  • What soundproofing or isolation methods are used? The mass wall isolation provides effective sound containment, maintaining consistent acoustic integrity.
  • How are session fees determined? Fees are set after acceptance to accommodate specific user needs and project requirements, ensuring fair and flexible pricing.
